'''Reegesk''' was a [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] and [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="CSWE" /> tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Aralia">{{CSWECite|I|39|Aralia}}</ref> [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]]. He regularly traded with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref>

Reegesk known as a fair trader. He regularly traded with [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] such as [[Het Nkik/Legends|Het Nkik]]. Reegesk was not picky, and was willing to steal anything, even trash. His tribe needed power for their bootleg [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporator]] unit, so he went into [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to look for a power source. He attempted to trade a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] battle idol to Nkik in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], during which he quietly stole the power source of Nkik's [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44]] for use with his tribe's vaporator, leading to the death of Nkik, not knowing his gun had no power during a shootout with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

==Behind the scenes==
Reegesk was played by [[Sadie Edon|Sadie Eden]].
